title: 624th Consecutive Dividend
summary: The post 624th Consecutive Dividend appeared first on The York Water Company .
body_markdown:
**York, Pennsylvania, November 24, 2026:** The York Water Company’s (NASDAQ: YORW) President and CEO, JT Hand, announced today that the Board of Directors at their November 23rd meeting declared a quarterly dividend of $0.2372 per share, a 4% increase. The dividend is payable January 15, 2027, to shareholders as of record date December 31, 2026.


This is the 624th consecutive dividend to be paid by The York Water Company. JT Hand, President and CEO, stated, “Reaching 30 consecutive years of dividend increases is a testament to York Water’s continued financial strength and the Board’s confidence in the Company’s long-term direction. Our ongoing investments in water and wastewater infrastructure demonstrate our commitment to maintaining and improving the systems that allow us to deliver safe, reliable, and sustainable service to our growing customer base. With more than 200 years of history behind us, we remain focused on balancing shareholder value with strategic investments that support future growth and ensure we are well-positioned to serve our communities for generations to come.”


York Water, which is the oldest publicly traded company in the nation, has never missed a dividend in over 210 years. This is believed to be the longest record of consecutive dividends in America.
